2608.14179.title: Can Language Models Understand mmWave Data? Benchmarking Large Language Models for mmWave Radar-Based Human Understanding
2608.14179.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable reasoning and generative capabilities, motivating their use as universal reasoning engines for perception. While modern approaches such as vision-language models (VLMs) have attempted to incorporate reasoning capabilities into visual sensing, the integration of LLMs with the millimeter-wave (mmWave) modality-despite its unique advantages under low light and occlusion-remains largely unexplored. The principal bottlenecks stem from the scarcity of radar language pairs, severe cross-dataset heterogeneity, and the absence of a foundational mmWave encoder. We address this gap through a minimal textualization interface that serializes each mmWave point cloud into concise natural language, allowing off-the-shelf LLMs to operate in a question answering (QA) setting. Building on this, we present mmWave-QA, the first benchmark for language-conditioned mmWave human perception. mmWave-QA aggregates heterogeneous public mmWave datasets and harmonizes them via calibration-aware preprocessing and global taxonomy alignment, while providing natural language QA. Spanning six scenarios and five QA tasks, the benchmark enables standardized evaluation across diverse mmWave hardware and experimental conditions, establishing a foundation for scalable research on mmWave-LLM integration. We further evaluate and analyze LLMs on our mmWave-QA, highlighting their zero-shot reasoning potential for radar perception, as well as their robustness under visual degradation.
2608.14179.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）展現了卓越的推理和生成能力，促使它們被用作感知的通用推理引擎。雖然現代方法如視覺-語言模型（VLMs）試圖將推理能力融入視覺感知，但LLMs與毫米波（mmWave）模態的整合——儘管在低光和遮擋下有其獨特優勢——仍然在很大程度上未被探索。主要瓶頸來自於雷達語言對的稀缺、跨數據集的嚴重異質性以及缺乏基礎的mmWave編碼器。我們通過一個最小的文本化介面來解決這一空白，該介面將每個mmWave點雲序列化為簡潔的自然語言，使現成的LLMs能夠在問答（QA）環境中運作。在此基礎上，我們提出了mmWave-QA，這是針對語言條件的mmWave人類感知的首個基準。mmWave-QA聚合了異質的公共mmWave數據集，並通過考慮校準的預處理和全球分類法對齊來協調它們，同時提供自然語言的QA。涵蓋六種場景和五個QA任務，該基準使得在不同的mmWave硬體和實驗條件下進行標準化評估成為可能，為mmWave-LLM整合的可擴展研究奠定了基礎。我們進一步在mmWave-QA上評估和分析LLMs，突顯了它們在雷達感知中的零樣本推理潛力，以及在視覺退化下的穩健性。
